def min_cost_to_sort(N, P):
    # Initialize the minimum total cost to a large number
    min_total_cost = float('inf')
    # Initialize the list to store the operations
    operations = []
    
    # Function to calculate the cost of swapping two elements
    def cost(i, j):
        return abs(i - j)
    
    # Function to perform the swap and update the permutation
    def swap(i, j):
        P[i], P[j] = P[j], P[i]
    
    # Function to check if the permutation is sorted
    def is_sorted(P):
        return all(P[i] <= P[i + 1] for i in range(N - 1))
    
    # Function to find the minimum total cost to sort the permutation
    def find_min_cost(P):
        nonlocal min_total_cost, operations
        current_cost = 0
        current_operations = []
        
        # Try all possible swaps
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(i + 1, N):
                # Perform the swap
                swap(i, j)
                current_cost += cost(i, j)
                current_operations.append((i + 1, j + 1))
                
                # Check if the permutation is sorted
                if is_sorted(P):
                    if current_cost < min_total_cost:
                        min_total_cost = current_cost
                        operations = current_operations.copy()
                else:
                    # Recursively find the minimum cost for the new permutation
                    find_min_cost(P)
                
                # Undo the swap
                swap(i, j)
                current_cost -= cost(i, j)
                current_operations.pop()
    
    # Start finding the minimum cost
    find_min_cost(P)
    
    return min_total_cost, len(operations), operations
